updates.title: Stewardship: A New Sunday Evening Seies
updates.excerpt: Stewardship: A New Sunday Evening Seies
updates.content: We are excited to announce that our Sunday Evening Bible Study will focus on the theme of Stewardship for the remainder of the year. We invite you to join us as we explore God’s Word, grow in our understanding, and encourage one another in our faith.

updates.title: Sunday Evening Bible Study Closed for National Women's Day Holiday

updates.content: Sunday evening Bible study will not commence on National Women's Day. We encourage everyone to spend this special day with their families and loved ones.

updates.title: Mukanyo Bible Study Resumes
updates.excerpt: Our Mukanyo Bible study programme will resume Sunday evenings starting May 24th.
updates.content: Our Mukanyo Bible study program resumes Sunday evening, May 24th. We invite everyone to join us as we discuss our next topic: Teenagers and Children. This is a great opportunity for parents and youth to grow together in faith. We look forward to seeing you there!
